summary: Mooij Agro is a Dutch maker of climate control, ventilation and automation systems for potato and other crop stores, based in Hegelsom and Horst in Limburg. Founded in 1981, it has been part of Hotraco Group since 2001. Its dealer network is active in 21 countries.
machines: Croptimiz-r MAX: 12-inch controller for facilities with several storage cells
Croptimiz-r Compact: 7-inch controller for one or two storage cells
Croptimiz-r PC management programme: shows, saves and exports store data
Smart Cooling Manager: coordinates cooling cells, cooling units and ventilation
Smart Energy Manager: estimates power use, peak shaving and priority power sharing among cells
iHotraco Storage Data: collects and stores storage data centrally in the cloud
Bulk store ventilation: floor and duct ventilation systems
Box store ventilation: pressure, aspiration, room and letterbox pressure ventilation
Exact-Air: full-length air and humidity system
CO2 Exchange kits: extract CO2 and replace it with fresh air
markets: Europe, including the Netherlands, Germany, Denmark, Poland, Finland and Ukraine
facts: Part of Hotraco Group since 2001; Hotraco was founded in 1974
Argentina project: 10 cells of 1,800 tons each, 18,000 tons in total
Garmann Landwirtschaft project: box storage of about 4,000 tonnes in three rooms
Denmark project: 2,000-ton box store for seed potatoes, completed 2017
limitations: No technical specifications such as capacity, airflow or power are published for any product.
Staff numbers, revenue and installation totals are not published, and no general email address is given.
The legal entity named on the site is Hotraco Agri B.V.; the ownership links between Speria, Munters and Hotraco are not fully stated.
